deadline.value: Fall: January 15 for international applicants (February 1 for Canadian residents); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: February 1 (Canadian resident) | January 15 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

supervisor.value: You must secure a supervisor before applying and upload their approval letter; no offer is made until a supervisor match is made.
supervisor.quote: You are required to secure a supervisor when applying. | An admission offer will not be issued until a supervisor match has been made.

also.quote: A thesis supervisor chosen by mutual agreement among the student, the Graduate Studies Committee and the potential supervisor.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: An MSc in life sciences with at least a B average is required.
